code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-color separator lines divide the canvas into matching regions.
    rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Separators in these tasks use one color (the same color at their intersection).

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    # Ignore separators that are not part of the separating cross/stripes by retaining
    # only lines whose color is consistent across their intersection structure.
    if not rows and not cols:
        return out
    # Source is the first non-separator region; all regions are filled from it.
    r0, r1 = rbounds[0] + 1, rbounds[1]
    c0, c1 = cbounds[0] + 1, cbounds[1]
    if r1 <= r0 or c1 <= c0:

    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):

            for r in range(ra, rz):

steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-color separator lines divide the canvas into matching regions.
    rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]
    # Separators in these tasks use one color (the same color at their intersection).
    # Select the central tile as the source, and tile its contents into every region.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    # Ignore separators that are not part of the separating cross/stripes by retaining
    # only lines whose color is consistent across their intersection structure.
    if not rows and not cols:
        return out
    # Use the populated tile as the source; blank surrounding tiles are targets.
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        ra, rz = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            ca, cz = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            if rz > ra and cz > ca:
                regions.append((ri, ci, ra, rz, ca, cz))
    source = max(regions, key=lambda q: sum(v != 0 for row in grid[q[2]:q[3]] for v in row[q[4]:q[5]]))
    sri, sci, r0, r1, c0, c1 = source
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        ra, rz = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        if rz-ra != r1-r0: continue
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            ca, cz = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            if cz-ca != c1-c0: continue
            if ri == sri and ci == sci: continue
            for r in range(ra, rz):
                for c in range(ca, cz):
                    out[r][c] = grid[r0 + r-ra][c0 + c-ca]
    return out
